summary: A docs folder whose remote rewrote two lines of one file
description: docs-conflicting-remote with a second conflict: both sides rewrote the line under Phase 1 and the line under Phase 2, with unchanged lines between them, so a pull stops with two regions in one document. What a document needs to be resolved a side at a time, one region after the other.

write.docs/roadmap.md:
# Roadmap

## Phase 1 — MVP

M2 closes with full-text search.

A stretch of text neither side touched, long enough that git keeps the two
conflicts apart instead of joining them into one region.

One more line between them.
And another.
And another still.
And one more, so the distance is beyond doubt.

## Phase 2

Phase 2 ships on Monday.
